title: पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Hearing Krishna, Subhadra weeps for her son, calling him by name and asking how she can bear the world without him. Draupadi and Uttara weep with her, and Krishna comforts them and leaves.
summary.kn: ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಸುಭದ್ರೆ ಮಗನ ಹೆಸರಿಡಿದು ಅಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ಅವನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಿಸುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ದ್ರೌಪದಿ, ಉತ್ತರೆ ಜೊತೆ ಅಳುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಸಂತೈಸಿ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कृष्ण की बात सुनकर सुभद्रा पुत्र का नाम लेकर रोती है और पूछती है कि उसके बिना संसार कैसे सहे। द्रौपदी और उत्तरा साथ रोती हैं, और कृष्ण उन्हें सान्त्वना देकर चल देते हैं।
summary.te: కృష్ణుని మాటలు విని సుభద్ర కొడుకు పేరు పిలుస్తూ ఏడుస్తుంది; అతడు లేని లోకాన్ని ఎలా భరించనని అంటుంది. ద్రౌపది, ఉత్తర కలిసి ఏడుస్తారు; కృష్ణుడు ఓదార్చి వెళతాడు.
summary.ta: கண்ணனின் சொற்களைக் கேட்டுச் சுபத்திரை மகனின் பெயர் சொல்லி அழுகிறாள்; அவன் இல்லாத உலகை எப்படித் தாங்குவேன் என்கிறாள். திரௌபதியும் உத்தரையும் சேர்ந்து அழ, கண்ணன் தேற்றிப் புறப்படுகிறார்.
summary.ml: കൃഷ്ണന്റെ വാക്കുകൾ കേട്ട് സുഭദ്ര മകനെ പേരുചൊല്ലി വിളിച്ച് കരയുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹമില്ലാതെ ലോകത്ത് എങ്ങനെ ജീവിക്കുമെന്ന് അവർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ദ്രൗപദിയും ഉത്തരയും അവരോടൊപ്പം കരയുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണൻ അവരെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിച്ചശേഷം പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.55; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः ।
सुभद्रा पुत्रशोकार्ता विललाप सुदुःखिता ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these words of the great-souled Keshava, Subhadra, afflicted with grief for her son, lamented in deep misery.

verses.text:
हा पुत्र मम मन्दायाः कथं संयुगमेत्य ह ।
निधनं प्राप्तवांस्तात पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: "Alas, my son! How, unlucky as I am, did you meet your end in battle, child, you who were equal to your father in prowess?"

verses.text:
कथमिन्दीवरश्यामं सुदंष्ट्रं चारुलोचनम् ।
मुखं ते दृश्यते वत्स गुण्ठितं रणरेणुना ॥

meaning.en: "How is it that I see your face, dark like a blue lotus, with its fine teeth and lovely eyes, smeared with the dust of battle, my dear?"

verses.text:
नूनं शूरं निपतितं त्वां पश्यन्त्यनिवर्तिनम् ।
सुशिरोग्रीवबाह्वंसं व्यूढोरस्कं निरूदरम् ॥

meaning.en: "Surely the creatures see you fallen, a brave man who never retreated, with your fine head, neck, arms and shoulders, broad chest and slim waist."

verses.text:
चारूपचितसर्वाङ्गं स्वक्षं शस्त्रक्षताचितम् ।
भूतानि त्वा निरीक्षन्ते नूनं चन्द्रमिवोदितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Surely they gaze at you as at the risen moon, your whole body beautiful, with lovely eyes, covered with weapon wounds."

verses.text:
शयनीयं पुरा यस्य स्पर्ध्यास्तरणसंवृतम् ।
भूमावद्य कथं शेषे विप्रविद्धः सुखोचितः ॥

meaning.en: "You whose bed was once spread with costly coverings, how do you lie today on the ground, thrown down, though you were used to comfort?"

verses.text:
योऽन्वास्यत पुरा वीरो वरस्त्रीभिर्महाभुजः ।
कथमन्वास्यते सोऽद्य शिवाभिः पतितो मृधे ॥

meaning.en: "You, mighty-armed hero, who were once attended by the finest women, how are you attended today, fallen in battle, by jackals?"

verses.text:
योऽस्तूयत पुरा हृष्टैः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः ।
सोऽद्य क्रव्याद्गणैर्घोरैर्विनदद्भिरुपास्यते ॥

meaning.en: "You who were once praised by joyful charioteers, bards and panegyrists, are now surrounded by hosts of terrible, howling flesh-eaters."

verses.text:
पाण्डवेषु च नाथेषु वृष्णिवीरेषु चाभिभो ।
पाञ्चालेषु च वीरेषु हतः केनास्यनाथवत् ॥

meaning.en: "While the Pandavas, Vrishni heroes and Panchala heroes were your protectors, who struck you down as if you had no protector?"

verses.text:
अतृप्तदर्शना पुत्र दर्शनस्य तवानघ ।
मन्दभाग्या गमिष्यामि व्यक्तमद्य यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: "Innocent son, I was never satisfied with the sight of you. Unlucky as I am, I shall surely go to Yama's abode today."

verses.text:
विशालाक्षं सुकेशान्तं चारुवाक्यं सुगन्धि च ।
तव पुत्र कदा भूयो मुखं द्रक्ष्यामि निर्व्रणम् ॥

meaning.en: "Son, when shall I see again your unblemished face, with its large eyes, lovely hair, sweet words and fragrance?"

verses.text:
धिग्बलं भीमसेनस्य धिक्पार्थस्य धनुष्मताम् ।
धिग्वीर्यं वृष्णिवीराणां पाञ्चालानां च धिग्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Shame on Bhimasena's strength, shame on Partha and the archers, shame on the valour of the Vrishni heroes and the strength of the Panchalas."

verses.text:
धिक्केकयांस्तथा चेदीन्मत्स्यांश्चैवाथ सृञ्जयान् ।
ये त्वा रणे गतं वीरं न जानन्ति निपातितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Shame on the Kekayas, the Chedis, the Matsyas and the Srinjayas, who did not know when you had gone into battle and were struck down."

verses.text:
अद्य पश्यामि पृथिवीं शून्यामिव हतत्विषम् ।
अभिमन्युमपश्यन्ती शोकव्याकुललोचना ॥

meaning.en: "Today I see the earth as empty, as if its lustre were lost, for my eyes are blind with grief and I cannot see Abhimanyu."

verses.text:
स्वस्रीयं वासुदेवस्य पुत्रं गाण्डीवधन्वनः ।
कथं त्वा विरथं वीरं द्रक्ष्याम्यन्यैर्निपातितम् ॥

meaning.en: "You, nephew of Vasudeva and son of the Gandiva archer, how shall I see you, a hero, chariotless and struck down by others?"

verses.text:
हा वीर दृष्टो नष्टश्च धनं स्वप्न इवासि मे ।
अहो ह्यनित्यं मानुष्यं जलबुद्बुदचञ्चलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Alas, hero! Seen and lost, you were like wealth seen in a dream to me. How impermanent is human life, as unsteady as a bubble on water."

verses.text:
इमां ते तरुणीं भार्यां त्वदाधिभिरभिप्लुताम् ।
कथं संधारयिष्यामि विवत्सामिव धेनुकाम् ॥

meaning.en: "How shall I support this young wife of yours, overwhelmed by grief for you, like a cow whose calf is gone?"

verses.text:
अहो ह्यकाले प्रस्थानं कृतवानसि पुत्रक ।
विहाय फलकाले मां सुगृद्धां तव दर्शने ॥

meaning.en: "Alas, my son, you set out at the wrong time, leaving me just at the time of fruit, when I was so eager to see you."

verses.text:
नूनं गतिः कृतान्तस्य प्राज्ञैरपि सुदुर्विदा ।
यत्र त्वं केशवे नाथे संग्रामेऽनाथवद्धतः ॥

meaning.en: "Surely the course of the Ender is hard to understand even for the wise, since you were killed in battle as if unprotected, though Keshava was your protector."

verses.text:
यज्वनां दानशीलानां ब्राह्मणानां कृतात्मनाम् ।
चरितब्रह्मचर्याणां पुण्यतीर्थावगाहिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of those who sacrifice, who give, of purified brahmins, of those who have kept celibacy and bathed at sacred places,"

verses.text:
कृतज्ञानां वदान्यानां गुरुशुश्रूषिणामपि ।
सहस्रदक्षिणानां च या गतिस्तामवाप्नुहि ॥

meaning.en: "of the grateful, the generous, those who serve their teachers, and those who give a thousand fees, may you reach that goal."

verses.text:
या गतिर्युध्यमानानां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम् ।
हत्वारीन्निहतानां च संग्रामे तां गतिं व्रज ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of brave men who fight and never turn back, and who die in battle after killing their enemies, go to that goal."

verses.text:
गोसहस्रप्रदातॄणां क्रतुदानां च या गतिः ।
नैवेशिकं चाभिमतं ददतां या गतिः शुभा ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of those who give a thousand cows, who give for sacrifices, and who give the dwelling they hold dear, a blessed goal."

verses.text:
ब्रह्मचर्येण यां यान्ति मुनयः संशितव्रताः ।
एकपत्न्यश्च यां यान्ति तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "The goal that firm-vowed sages reach by celibacy, and that men devoted to one wife reach, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
राज्ञां सुचरितैर्या च गतिर्भवति शाश्वती ।
चतुराश्रमिणां पुण्यैः पावितानां सुरक्षितैः ॥

meaning.en: "The eternal goal that kings gain through good conduct, and that those of the four orders of life gain, purified by merit and well guarded,"

verses.text:
दीनानुकम्पिनां या च सततं संविभागिनाम् ।
पैशुन्याच्च निवृत्तानां तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "the goal of those who are always compassionate to the poor, who share, and who have abstained from slander, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
व्रतिनां धर्मशीलानां गुरुशुश्रूषिणामपि ।
अमोघातिथिनां या च तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of those who keep vows, who are devoted to dharma, who serve teachers, and whose hospitality is never fruitless, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
ऋतुकाले स्वकां पत्नीं गच्छतां या मनस्विनाम् ।
न चान्यदारसेवीनां तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of high-minded men who approach only their own wives in season and never serve another's wife, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
साम्ना ये सर्वभूतानि गच्छन्ति गतमत्सराः ।
नारुंतुदानां क्षमिणां या गतिस्तामवाप्नुहि ॥

meaning.en: "Those who approach all beings gently, free of envy, who do not hurt others and are forgiving: may you reach their goal."

verses.text:
मधुमांसनिवृत्तानां मदाद्दम्भात्तथानृतात् ।
परोपतापत्यक्तानां तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "The goal of those who abstain from honey and meat, from intoxication, pride and falsehood, who give up troubling others, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
ह्रीमन्तः सर्वशास्त्रज्ञा ज्ञानतृप्ता जितेन्द्रियाः ।
यां गतिं साधवो यान्ति तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: "The goal that modest, learned, wisdom-satisfied and self-controlled good people reach, go to that goal, my son."

verses.text:
एवं विलपतीं दीनां सुभद्रां शोककर्शिताम् ।
अभ्यपद्यत पाञ्चाली वैराटीसहिता तदा ॥

meaning.en: As Subhadra, thin with grief, lamented thus in misery, Draupadi came to her then with Virata's daughter.

verses.text:
ताः प्रकामं रुदित्वा च विलप्य च सुदुःखिताः ।
उन्मत्तवत्तदा राजन्विसंज्ञा न्यपतन्क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: After weeping and lamenting greatly in their distress, O king, they fell senseless to the ground like madwomen.

verses.text:
सोपचारस्तु कृष्णस्तां दुःखितां भृशदुःखितः ।
सिक्त्वाम्भसा समाश्वास्य तत्तदुक्त्वा हितं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, also in great grief, performed the proper acts, sprinkled water on her, comforted her, and spoke various helpful words.

verses.text:
विसंज्ञकल्पां रुदतीमपविद्धां प्रवेपतीम् ।
भगिनीं पुण्डरीकाक्ष इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: The lotus-eyed one spoke these words to his sister, who was as if unconscious, weeping, thrown down and trembling.

verses.text:
सुभद्रे मा शुचः पुत्रं पाञ्चाल्याश्वासयोत्तराम् ।
गतोऽभिमन्युः प्रथितां गतिं क्षत्रियपुंगवः ॥

meaning.en: "Subhadra, do not grieve for your son. Comfort Uttara, Panchali. Abhimanyu, bull among kshatriyas, has gone to a renowned goal."

verses.text:
ये चान्येऽपि कुले सन्ति पुरुषा नो वरानने ।
सर्वे ते वै गतिं यान्तु अभिमन्योर्यशस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: "Fair-faced one, may all the other men of our family likewise go to the goal of the glorious Abhimanyu."

verses.text:
कुर्याम तद्वयं कर्म क्रियासुः सुहृदश्च नः ।
कृतवान्यादृगद्यैकस्तव पुत्रो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: "May we and our friends, eager to act, do the deed that your son, the great chariot-warrior, did alone today."

verses.text:
एवमाश्वास्य भगिनीं द्रौपदीमपि चोत्तराम् ।
पार्थस्यैव महाबाहुः पार्श्वमागादरिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Having comforted his sister and also Draupadi and Uttara, the mighty-armed destroyer of foes went to Partha's side.

verses.text:
ततोऽभ्यनुज्ञाय नृपान्कृष्णो बन्धूंस्तथाभिभूः ।
विवेशान्तःपुरं राजंस्तेऽन्ये जग्मुर्यथालयम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord Krishna dismissed the kings and kinsmen and entered the inner apartments, O king, and the others went each to his own quarters.
